claims: Tennessee State University is a public university.
Tennessee State University is a historically black land-grant university.
Tennessee State University is an HBCU.
Tennessee State University is located in Nashville, Tennessee.
Tennessee State University was founded in 1912.
Enrollment at Tennessee State University is approximately 6,310 in Fall 2024.
The acceptance rate at Tennessee State University is approximately 60-70%.
TSU Tigers compete in the Ohio Valley Conference (OVC).
Tuition at Tennessee State University is approximately $8,616 for in-state students.
Tuition at Tennessee State University is approximately $22,416 for out-of-state students.
Tennessee State University is a member of the Thurgood Marshall College Fund.
Billboard recognized Tennessee State University as a top music business school.
The TSU men's basketball team qualified for the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
The TSU men's basketball team faced Iowa State in the first round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
